items.title: RED: reproduce an unbounded repeat-block loop against a phase gate
items.context: Write a failing test that drives the same gate to refuse N times with an identical block reason (findings attributed to main agent, artifact=test-evidence.json) and asserts that some breaker stops it. It must fail today, proving no repeat-block detection exists. Model the reason on the B-4043 transcript evidence: 61 identical refusals against 54 re-review rounds.

happy.desc: gateFailureDigest(cmd, reasonA) vs gateFailureDigest(cmd, reasonB) where both reasons share identical first 200 normalized chars but differ at char 250 (e.g. different Diagnostic gaps list) -> both return the same digest key today (RED: proves .slice(0,200) truncation discards distinguishing content); WHY: reproduces the exact B-cc54 root cause at the unit level

bumpGateFailureCount called sequentially with 3 distinct ProofStory-style blockers (missing intent snapshot / missing acceptance binding / missing verificationIntentRefs) all sharing the invariant 200-char header -> maxGateFailureCount returns 3 on a single collapsed key instead of 1 per distinct key (RED: proves false counter inflation from digest collision); WHY: end-to-end consequence of the digest bug on the counter subsystem

edge.desc: gateFailureDigest with reason exactly 200 chars after normalization -> digest is stable; appending one distinguishing char at position 201 still produces the SAME digest (RED: boundary proof that .slice(0,200) discards char 201); WHY: boundary condition at the exact truncation point

adversarial.desc: Two reasons where raw text looks very different (mixed case, real /paths/to/files, real timestamps 2026-07-23T12:00:00Z, hex IDs a1b2c3d4e5f6) but normalization (lowercase + digits-># + paths-># + hex->#) makes first 200 chars identical while tails genuinely differ -> same digest despite semantically unrelated blockers; WHY: normalization amplifies the collision surface beyond naive identical-prefix construction

Three sequential bumpGateFailureCount with distinct real ProofStory blockers sharing the invariant header -> assessBreaker sees maxGateRepeat>=2 (threshold), first trip auto-recovers, counter rebuilds to >=2 again on fresh window -> freeze; isInteractiveAckAllowed returns false without TTY -> unattended run permanently stuck on a genuinely progressing story; WHY: proves the full end-to-end user-facing impact (token burn + permanent freeze) of the digest collision

items.title: Record consecutive identical gate blocks per story
items.context: Add a repeat-block ledger keyed on (storyId, gate, digest of the block reason). Increment on an identical consecutive block; reset when the gate passes or the block reason changes, so a genuinely progressing review is never penalised.

items.title: Hard-stop after the threshold and name the unmet precondition
items.context: When the counter reaches the threshold (default 3), stop the loop and emit a diagnostic that states the actual unmet precondition rather than a generic refusal, e.g. that findings lack agent attribution and that re-review cannot clear it because attribution is fixed at finding_add time.

items.title: Keep the breaker fail-closed and non-forging
items.context: Prove by test that tripping the breaker never marks the gate satisfied, never rewrites finding attribution, and never advances the phase. The breaker only stops and reports; review independence must remain intact.

items.title: Smoke coverage for fire, no-fire and reset
items.context: Cover three cases: breaker fires at the threshold on identical repeated blocks; breaker does NOT fire when the block reason changes between attempts; counter resets after the gate passes. Register the smoke in the validate command set.
